description_en: Temporarily adjusts the internal network bandwidth of an ApsaraDB for Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 临时调整专属集群中云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的内网带宽
name: ModifyIntranetAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth to add, in MB/s. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to 0. Typically, the maximum value is twice the default maximum bandwidth of the current instance type. For bandwidth information about each instance type, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html. However, the following limits also apply:
The bandwidth of a single instance cannot exceed 75% of the bandwidth of the host on which the instance resides. For information about host specifications and bandwidth, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html.
The total bandwidth of all instances on a host cannot exceed 150% of the bandwidth of the host. You can configure overcommitment to meet bandwidth requirements for staggered-peak deployment. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183798.html.

For instances that use the standard architecture, if you do not specify this parameter, the bandwidth of the instance is doubled based on the current bandwidth
parameters.help_zh:
要增加的带宽，单位为MB/s。取值为大于等于0的整数。通常最大可传入当前实例规格默认最大带宽的2倍（规格对应带宽信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26350.html），但是也存在下述限制：
单实例的带宽不能超过所在主机的75%，主机规格及其带宽信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html。
所在主机上所有实例的带宽总和不能超过所在主机的150%，您可以设置超配满足错峰部署的带宽使用。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183798.html。

标准架构的实例如果不传入本参数，该实例的带宽会在当前带宽的基础上增加一倍
parameters.name: band_width

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the data node. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473783.html to query the ID. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
This parameter is available and required only when the instance uses the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据节点ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473783.html获取，传入多个时使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当实例为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52228.html时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: node_id
